description: This file contains the implementation of event handlers and utility functions related to the HelpDesk module in vtiger CRM, including event handling for entity save events, notification functions for portal ticket creation and comments, and email notification logic.

classes.name: HelpDeskHandler
classes.description: Event handler class for HelpDesk-related events, particularly after-save final events to update ticket status.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles specific vtiger entity events; in this case, updates 'from_portal' status after a HelpDesk ticket is saved.
